title: Host self-spawns resolve the mutable target/release/termal.exe path: an install leaves review checks and MCP spawns failing (os error 2) or running a newer binary
outcome: No host self-spawn (review freeze checker, delegation MCP servers) fails or silently runs a different binary because an install replaced target/release/termal.exe; and the install procedure never leaves that path empty.
acceptance: Host self-spawns resolve the mutable target/release/termal.exe path: an install leaves review checks and MCP spawns failing (os error 2) or running a newer binary is done
